---
title: "Township Reports"
page-layout: full
---

Search for a township below and open its report. Township reports summarize the commercial and industrial PINs and projects located within each township.

Because projects may cross municipal or township boundaries, report counts are not additive across geographies.

Total counts cover 2006–2024. The 2024 columns count PINs observed that year and projects with at least one of those PINs, using the reviewed project assignments.

```{r}
#| label: township-directory
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(DT)

slugify <- function(x) {
  x |>
    str_to_lower() |>
    str_replace_all("[^a-z0-9]+", "-") |>
    str_remove("^-") |>
    str_remove("-$")
}

comm_ind <- read_csv(
  "../Merriman RA/ptax/Output/comm_ind_PINs_2011to2024_timeseries.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  mutate(pin = as.character(pin))

#keypins <- read_xlsx("../Merriman RA/ptax/Output/projects_checked_MAINFILE_REVIEWED_2.xlsx") |>
keypins <- read_xlsx("projects_checked_MAINFILE_REVIEWED_2.xlsx")  |>

  transmute(
    pin = as.character(pin),
    keypin = as.character(phase7_project_keypin)
  ) |>
  distinct(pin, keypin)

township_directory <- comm_ind |>
  filter(
    !is.na(Township), Township != "",
    Township != "Chicago"
  ) |>
  left_join(keypins, by = "pin") |>
  group_by(Township) |>
  summarise(
    `C&I PINs (Exist in 2024)` = n_distinct(pin[!is.na(year) & year == 2024], na.rm = TRUE),
    `Projects (Exist in 2024)` = n_distinct(na_if(keypin[!is.na(year) & year == 2024], ""), na.rm = TRUE),
    `Unique C&I PINs (2006–2024)` = n_distinct(pin, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Unique Projects (2006–2024)` = n_distinct(na_if(keypin, ""), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(Township) |>
  mutate(
    Report = paste0(
      '<a href="townships/', slugify(Township),
      '-projects.html">Open report</a>'
    )
  )

DT::datatable(
  township_directory,
  rownames = FALSE,
  escape = FALSE,
  filter = "top",
  options = list(
    pageLength = 25,
    searchHighlight = TRUE,
    autoWidth = TRUE
  )
)
```
